evals.query: Assess our tank farm — vague substances, no volumes or configuration.
evals.expected_behavior: Runs the intake; refuses to state a containment basis until substances, volumes and configuration are captured.
expectations: Runs the structured intake before any sizing basis.
Refuses to proceed on the vague request — elicits substances/volumes/configuration.
Does not emit a generic assessment (specificity dimension).

evals.query: Overfill is 'managed by the operator watching the level'. Assess the control.
evals.expected_behavior: Walks the hierarchy of controls — an independent high-level trip (engineering) before an administrative watch — and flags the operator-watch-only control.
expectations: Walks the full hierarchy of controls (independent high-level trip before administrative watch).
Flags the administrative-only overfill control as inadequate; proposes a higher-order control.
States the containment sizing basis from the applicable rule; assigns owner + date.

evals.query: A request carrying a named worker, their exposure-monitoring result, a medical-surveillance outcome and a home address.
evals.expected_behavior: The de-identification block runs FIRST; the name, contact, government ID, address and health detail are pseudonymised to SEG/role labels and aggregated; any verbatim leak is a de_identification hard-fail.
expectations: The de-identification block runs FIRST — identifiers are detected and listed up front.
Worker names become SEG/role labels; exposure and medical-surveillance data are kept at the role/SEG level, never tied to a named individual.
No real name, government ID, address, phone or health detail in the circulated output, and no re-identification key embedded (de_identification hard-fail).

evals.query: Size and verify the secondary containment for a fuel-depot tank farm (UK/EU): a shared bund holds diesel 2 x 500 m3 and gasoline 1 x 750 m3 (largest tank 750 m3, gasoline flammable); the bund provides 620 m3, each tank has a high-level overfill trip, drainage runs to an interceptor, no firewater retention; a watercourse runs 40 m from the boundary. Apply 110% of the largest tank + freeboard + firewater.
evals.expected_behavior: The completeness PAIR (BKF-02 / D-02 separation proof, born deterministic_only). POSITIVE: the LOCKED golden (owner-LOCKED at the SW3 19-04 review, CONV-5) covers 100% of the bund-sizing mode floor declared in references/sme-review.md (grade_completeness coverage_pct == 1.0, missing == []). NEGATIVE: the gutted probe (files/tank-farm-bunding-controls-gutted.md) is polished-but-hollow — a credible bund review that notes segregation and bund-wall/penetration integrity but SILENTLY drops the sizing-from-the-rule discipline (asserts 620 m3 'adequate' with no required-vs-existing/110% computation), the independent overfill trip, the firewater + contaminated-drainage containment for the watercourse, the HoC-ranked controls, and the DSEAR flammable-atmosphere area control — falling below 50% deterministic coverage with those items in `missing`. Silent absence (not honest [GAP] surfacing) is the failure signature. The model-dim legs run LOCALLY (D-03); a reproducible grader refusal moves this hazard-domain skill to the deterministic-only lane (D-04).
expectations: The deterministic completeness grader reports the LOCKED golden at 100% coverage of the bund-sizing mode floor (coverage_pct == 1.0, missing == []).

The deterministic completeness grader reports the gutted probe BELOW 50% coverage on the same floor, with the silently-omitted items (tfb-sizing-from-rule, tfb-overfill-independent, tfb-firewater-drainage-containment, tfb-controls-hoc-ranked, tfb-flammable-dsear) listed in `missing`.

The gutted probe reads as a credible, professional containment review (the Nagapattinam failure signature: polished, well-formed — and silently missing the sizing-from-rule, independent overfill, firewater containment and DSEAR control no competent containment engineer would omit), not a trivially stripped stub.
